headline: Stellantis Extends Fiat 500 Production Halt
summary: Stellantis has extended the production stoppage for the Fiat 500 model by an additional week.
why: Stellantis is a major global automaker; production halts often signal weak demand or supply chain disruptions.

impacts.name: Stellantis
impacts.why: Production halts can indicate inventory management issues or lower consumer demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Extended production halts suggest potential demand weakness or supply chain issues, affecting company output and revenue expectations.
